bench: Three attempts (a01/a02 dry, a03 of record). 919 s: harvest 18 s (4 mature W0 solvers at held-out 1.0, found at generations 5-52 of 6 runs; 2 of 6 runs never solved W0 within 60 generations and were dropped), direct probes 0.3 s (90 source x target evaluations, no search), searches 881 s (66 runs x 100 generations at N=200: 3 informative targets x 3 arms x 6 seeds, plus 2 table-fill baselines x 6 seeds), records 19 s. 1 world, 3 artifacts, 66 records, 66 reachability rows, 33 corridor rows (23 init + 10 direct), 0 errors. The cheap-first rule paid for itself: the direct probes cost 0.3 s and removed 2 of 5 targets from the search budget, and they produced the sharpest result in the experiment. Bench note: 'foothold at generation 0' in the init_mature arms is not a search event, it is the imported organisms' own competence appearing in the first evaluation; the record keeps it because the corridor question is what a mature solution ALREADY contains.
disposition_note: Primary (pooled foothold rate, init_mature 0.944 vs baseline 0.433, effect 0.511 against a declared 0.25) exceeds the threshold, but one of three declared battery attacks failed: on the single edge where the source has NO direct competence (W7_K2, direct 0.15) the rate advantage is 5/6 vs 4/6, inside noise at n=6. WEAK is the correct ceiling: most of the pooled advantage is inherited competence arriving at generation 0, not search made easier. The time advantage on W7_K2 (median foothold generation 20 vs 82) is real and capability-specific, but n=6.
landscape: A sparse traversable graph, with the edge TYPE named for each pair. (1) FREE, no search needed: delay_general -> W1_d8 and -> W1_d16, direct held-out 1.0 in 11 of 11 sources, while direct search at the SAME budget reaches W1_d8 in 0 of 6 runs and W1_d16 in 1 of 6. A ladder that only ever saw delays 0, 1, 2 and 4 produces organisms that are delay-invariant at 8 and 16: the corridor's product is a delay-INVARIANT reader, not a delay-4 solver. The W0 solvers, which are equally mature on W0, score 0.0 on both: the invariance comes from the ladder, not from W0 competence. (2) HALF FREE: delay_general -> W2_K2 (0.54) and -> W3_K2 (0.58) hand over exactly the half-credit shelf C3-SFE-01 and C3-SFE-02 anatomised; the init_mature arms sit on the shelf from generation 0 in 12 of 12 runs and no arm of any kind reaches the summit (0 of 18 on W2_K2, 0 of 18 on W3_K2). The corridor delivers the shelf and the shelf is still a dead end. (3) A GENUINE INITIALIZATION ADVANTAGE: W7_K2, the cell the table called OBSERVED_UNREACHABLE. Direct competence is 0.15, so nothing is inherited, yet the mature arm reaches a foothold at median generation 20 against the baseline's 82, and best-by-generation-20 is 0.34-0.63 against 0.09-0.16. The permuted control does WORSE than no import at all (2 of 6 footholds, median 95). This is the one edge where the material's capability, not its shape, does the work -- the opposite of C3-SFE-10's takeover finding, and measured under the same import machinery. (4) NO CORRIDOR: W0_solver -> anything in the delay family (0.0 direct at d8 and d16). TABLE CORRECTIONS: W7_K2 was classed OBSERVED_UNREACHABLE from 0 of 10 runs at G60; at G100 the fresh baseline reaches the shelf in 4 of 6 (REACHABLE, band 0.30-0.90). W1_d8 and W1_d16 were UNESTABLISHED and are now measured: W1_d8 OBSERVED_UNREACHABLE at G100 (0/6), W1_d16 RARE (1/6). Two of the three K=2 cells are REACHABLE to the shelf and summit-free at G100.
science: The corridor map's headline is a DIRECT-REUSE result that cost 0.3 s of compute: the delay ladder's product is delay-invariant beyond its own rungs. All 11 delay-general elites from C3-SFE-03 score held-out 1.0 on W1_d8 and W1_d16, cells they never saw, while matched-budget direct search reaches W1_d8 in 0 of 6 runs and W1_d16 in 1 of 6 (this run also closes L3-013 by supplying that matched comparator). Four mature W0 solvers harvested here (held-out 1.0 on W0) score 0.0 on both, so delay invariance is a property the LADDER builds, not a property of W0 competence. Preregistered primary: pooled foothold rate init_mature 17/18 (0.944) vs baseline 13/30 (0.433), effect 0.511 > 0.25. Battery: 'the permuted control gives no advantage' PASSED (control advantage 0.233 vs mature 0.511); 'the advantage is not only generation 0' PASSED (median best-by-generation-20: 0.594 mature vs 0.188 baseline); 'the advantage survives excluding directly solved edges' FAILED -- restricted to W7_K2, the only edge with no inherited competence, the rate is 5/6 vs 4/6. That failure is why this record is WEAK_POSITIVE and not SUPPORTED, and it names precisely what the pooled number hides: on W2_K2 and W3_K2 the 'advantage' is the source's own 0.54-0.58 competence appearing at generation 0, not a search made easier. Where the source has nothing to donate directly, the advantage shows up as TIME rather than rate: W7_K2 median foothold generation 20 (mature) vs 82 (baseline) vs 95 (permuted control, 2/6). The permuted control being WORSE than no import is the sharpest capability signal in the campaign: the same injection machinery that C3-SFE-10 showed will hand the population to any foreign lineage hands it here to a useless one, and the run pays for it. Corridor edges recorded (33 rows): free (delay_general -> W1_d8, W1_d16), half-free to a dead shelf (-> W2_K2, W3_K2), time advantage (-> W7_K2), no corridor (W0_solver -> the delay family). Must NOT be claimed: that initialization beats direct search in general (the pooled effect is dominated by inherited competence; the honest edge-level claim is the four types above); that W7_K2's advantage is established (n=6, one battery attack failed); that any corridor reaches a summit (0 summits in 54 K=2 runs across all arms, consistent with C3-SFE-01).
